text: There is a certain sense of spaciousness in the first scene. I feel slightly detached, as if I am observing the world from an odd angle, both literally and figuratively. The people seem occupied with their own concerns. In the second scene, I am drawn in by curiosity. The exhibit seems vibrant and full of information. There is an energy of innovation and learning here, and as I stand close to another observer, I feel a subtle companionship in inquiry, yet remain lost in my own thoughts.
